brief_summary: Hero art for the guides-pillar buying guide comparing keyboard layout sizes (60%, 65%, 75%, TKL, full-size). Motif: five abstract keyboard-footprint outlines at graduated width, left to right, ascending from 60% to full-size, height held constant so width alone carries the size story.
source: plan/bearings.md § Article hero art — colorful keyboard SVGs, guide-pillar convention (annotated keyboard-row / layout silhouette treatment)
template: directive: simple line drawing + single splash of color illustrative of subject; guide default reinterpreted here as a size-comparison row of five silhouettes since the article's literal subject is layout footprints
subject: Five keyboard-shape outlines at ascending width, left to right — 60%, 65%, 75%, TKL, full-size. Height is constant across all five so width alone tells the size story. Ochre marks what each size step adds back: the arrow cluster appears at 65%, the function-row strip returns at 75%, a small nav-cluster dot grid joins at TKL, and a detached numpad block (the widest addition) appears only at full-size, carrying the focal dot. 60% is the only footprint with no ochre marks — it drops the arrow cluster entirely, the single most-cited fact distinguishing that size.
